consumer: An engine charge-counting possession predicate (Character::charges_of/has_charges-style call) asking 'does the avatar carry >=250 charges of water_clean across reachable carried inventory?'
scope: The full reachable carried inventory aggregated by charges, including water_clean charges held inside carried containers, not just top-level wielded/worn/inventory items
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items, which iterates only top-level wielded_items()/worn/inv_const_slice() and emits each item's raw charges without recursing into container contents or computing a typed charge total
divergence: 250 charges of water_clean stored inside a wielded/worn plastic bottle or canteen: the flat top-level iteration emits the bottle but never its water_clean contents, so an external re-sum reports 0 ('no') while the engine's charge-count predicate returns 250 ('yes')
